# billy

> billy is a free, open-source invoice editor. You click any line on the invoice and type, then download a print-ready PDF. There is no account and no server.

## What billy does
- Click-to-edit invoices with autosave, undo and redo, and a command palette
- 10 templates and 10 currencies, with tax, discount and payment terms
- GST support for India: GSTIN, HSN and SAC codes, CGST, SGST and IGST, and reverse charge
- Print-ready PDF export, generated in the browser
- Works on a phone

## Privacy
- Invoices are kept in the browser's local storage and are never uploaded.
- billy sends anonymous usage events to PostHog and asks GitHub for its star count. It does not send invoice contents anywhere.
